metadata.gitb:name: FHIR Validator ITB REST API smoke test
metadata.gitb:description: Exercises all GITB-aligned endpoints under /itb/* end to end: - igManager: load an IG - testdata: generate resources (required elements only) - fhir: validate against base spec and against an IG profile - matchetype: pattern-match a resource against an expected shape - fhirPath: evaluate (extract a value) - fhirPathAssertion: assert a boolean expression on a resource - validationResults: summarize an OperationOutcome
